speech-clean.wav.description: Clean reference talker (Klatt-style synthetic voice), two phrases, silent elsewhere.

noisy-speech.wav.description: speech-clean.wav plus steady pink noise at 5 dB SNR (speech-active samples) for the Light engine.

keyboard-voice.wav.description: speech-clean.wav plus keyboard clicks, a distant reverberant background talker and room tone; the interference RNNoise passes through.

speakerphone-far.wav.description: Far-end talker played by a call (echo-cancellation reference), speaking 0.3-5.0 s, 5.3-7.2 s and 7.5-9.7 s.

speakerphone-mic.wav.description: What a speakerphone microphone hears: speakerphone-far.wav through a compressing speaker, a 40 ms bulk delay and a decaying 100 ms room response, a near-end talker between 5.5 s and 6.9 s, and faint room tone.
